QuestInfo.name: Gift of the Fox God
QuestInfo.0: The Fox God calls, saying she has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: The Fox God calls, saying she has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.2: At the Fox God's behest, you came to Fox Point Village. You couldn't decide whether to feel happy or sad that Moonbeam isn't crying about you anymore. Speaking of, you ran into Moonbeam along your way. She excitedly showed you that her guardian looks like you. You leave the village thanking the Fox God for her blessing.
